title: The Spanish Inquisition of Hearts
logline: Alejandro says eleven words on his first morning, and breakfast becomes open warfare — Brock brings volume, Matteo brings four courses, and Élodie accidentally awards the highest score in villa history.

scenes.visual: Night firepit: Alejandro in crimson shirt and red-gold sash extends one hand to Élodie in breton stripes and navy beret; behind them Brock in his American-flag tank clutches a shaker bottle and Matteo in his tricolore apron freezes mid-stir, both faces collapsing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Alejandro has said eleven words all day.

lines.speaker: alejandro-spain
lines.text: Dance with me. The song will find us.

scenes.visual: Bright morning kitchen: Brock in flag tank and red backwards cap holds a screaming blender overhead like a trophy while Poppy in her Union Jack crop top shields her tea mug, one eyebrow fully raised.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: Full send on the heart, baby!
lines.delivery: shouting over the blender, no volume control

lines.speaker: poppy-uk
lines.text: That's not a smoothie. That's a threat.

scenes.visual: Matteo in Italian-flag apron slams down a four-course brunch spread, hands flying, glaring at Brock's lone pink smoothie; Élodie sits between them poking an egg with total indifference.

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: You made noise. I made brunch.

scenes.visual: Poolside: Alejandro reclines with a red carnation and empty hands while Élodie leans in slightly; Lucas in his open canary-yellow Brazil jersey stops mid-dance, grin flatlining into a stare.

lines.speaker: lucas-brazil
lines.text: He dances? That's my whole thing.

scenes.visual: Spill Room: Brock alone in his flag tank and star shorts, cap in his lap, smile too wide, shaker bottle sweating on his knee.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: Maybe loud isn't the same as wanted.

scenes.visual: Firelight: Alejandro spins Élodie slowly with no music anywhere, her cool stare finally cracking, red lip parted, beret slipping.
Morning terrace: Poppy leans in grinning as Élodie's cool mask shatters mid-sentence; behind them Brock's smoothie tips over untouched and Matteo drops a serving spoon, mouth open.

lines.speaker: elodie-france
lines.text: Six. ...I said that out loud. Non. NON.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: A SIX? I've been grinding for a five-point-five all week!

scenes.visual: Walkway at dusk: Alejandro strolls away in crimson and white, red carnation between his teeth, saying absolutely nothing, four question marks glowing over his head.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four words left. Nobody knows them.

caption: Élodie has never rated anything above a five. Then Alejandro danced with no music. 👀🇪🇸 Brock's blender will never recover. Is he genuine or just smooth?
musicDirection: Original royalty-free flamenco-adjacent guitar sting for Alejandro's entrances, comedic pizzicato under the blender-vs-brunch war, single warm nylon-string phrase for the no-music dance, and a distorted record-scratch bass drop on the historic six.
continuityNotes: Brock's $43 lemonade-stand secret from ep1 now fuels his confidence wobble — the volume is compensation.
Poppy defended Brock last episode; here she baits Élodie instead, still refusing sincerity.
Élodie's out-of-ten rating bit is formally established this episode (eggs: four) before the historic six.
Matteo's mozzarella suffering continues off-screen; dairy secret still ticking.
Lucas vs Alejandro sunshine-king cold war officially declared poolside.
Alejandro's remaining four unspoken words are a planted mystery for a later episode.
Greta-Matteo prize dinner still pending and unmentioned on screen.
